Container.Name: TR-Board
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted Trello with the paid features free — multi-user with team-gated visibility, real-time live sync, custom fields, Calendar/Timeline/Table/Dashboard views, unmetered Butler-style automation, admin controls, uncapped attachments, global search, "My Work", card dependencies, public intake forms, board export/copy, link sharing and card mirroring. React + Fastify + PostgreSQL.
REQUIRES a PostgreSQL 16 database — set DATABASE_URL to point at it (postgres://user:password@host:5432/trboard). The app refuses to start if DATABASE_URL is unset or has no password. The first account you register becomes the instance admin; after that registration is closed (admins add users) unless Allow Registration is true. Database migrations run automatically on start.
Container.Description: Self-hosted Trello with the paid features free: team-gated boards, live sync, custom fields, extra views and automation.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web UI is served on (host side). Change if 3850 is taken.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Connection string for your PostgreSQL 16 database, e.g. postgres://trboard:PASSWORD@192.168.1.10:5432/trboard. Required, must include a password; no default.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Where card attachments are stored (uncapped). The container runs as root so it can write here.

Config.Name: Allow Registration
Config.Description: Open self-sign-up. Leave false: the first account becomes admin, then admins create users in /admin. Set true only to let anyone who can reach the app register.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set when the app sits behind NGINX Proxy Manager or a Cloudflare tunnel, so rate limits see real client IPs and https is detected. Usual value: loopback,linklocal,uniquelocal (proxies on private addresses). Or a hop count (1), or proxy IPs/CIDRs. Leave empty for direct LAN access.

Config.Name: Cookie Secure
Config.Description: true = the session cookie is always Secure (https only); set this when people reach the app over https through a proxy. Empty = Secure only on requests that arrived over https. false = never.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Folder for scheduled backups (used when Backup Dir is /backups). An array share such as /mnt/user/backups/trboard is safer than appdata: a cache-pool failure then can't take the database and its backups together.

Config.Name: Backup Dir
Config.Description: Set to /backups to turn on scheduled backups (DB + attachments in one .tar.gz). Empty = off; Admin > Download backup works either way.

Config.Name: Backup Interval Hours
Config.Description: Hours between scheduled backups. Counted from the newest backup in the folder, so container restarts don't add extra ones.

Config.Name: Backup Keep
Config.Description: How many scheduled backups to keep; older ones are deleted.

Config.Name: Backup Max Restore GB
Config.Description: Largest backup file the Admin restore upload accepts.

Config.Name: OIDC Issuer
Config.Description: Single sign-on: the provider's issuer URL, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/tr-board/ (Authentik), https://auth.example.com (Authelia) or https://accounts.google.com. SSO is on when Issuer, Client ID and Redirect URI are all set.

Config.Name: OIDC Client ID
Config.Description: Client ID registered at the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC Client Secret
Config.Description: Client secret registered at the provider.

Config.Name: OIDC Redirect URI
Config.Description: https://YOUR-BOARD/api/auth/oidc/callback, registered at the provider exactly.

Config.Name: OIDC Token Auth Method
Config.Description: client_secret_basic or client_secret_post; match the provider's client setting.

Config.Name: OIDC Scopes
Config.Description: Scopes to request. email is required for account matching.

Config.Name: OIDC Button Label
Config.Description: Text of the SSO button on the login page.

Config.Name: OIDC Auto Provision
Config.Description: true = create an account on first SSO login for a verified email with no account. Only takes effect while Allow Registration is true.

Config.Name: OIDC Allow Insecure HTTP
Config.Description: Allow an http:// issuer (LAN-only identity provider). Never for an internet-facing one.

Config.Name: Session Days
Config.Description: How many days a login stays valid.
